artworks.title: Jacob Meyer-Heine
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink, verso reddened for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of an elderly man from the waist up, seated in a relaxed position. He is leaning slightly forward, resting his arms on the back of a chair. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose, pronounced cheekbones, and a full beard and mustache. His hair appears curly and is of medium length. The man is dressed in a buttoned suit with a collared shirt beneath. His hands are resting on the top of the chair. The background shows an outdoor scene with trees and shrubs. There is a window or doorway behind him. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing shading and linework for detail and texture.

artworks.title: Tomb of Plautius
artworks.medium: brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a cylindrical stone structure from a slightly elevated angle. A stone plaque with inscriptions is placed against the side of the structure. The horizon is not visible, and the structure fills the frame significantly. The drawing features loose and expressive brushstrokes, creating texture on the stone and a sketch-like quality. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with shades of brown, giving an aged or antique look to the piece.

artworks.title: Erminia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a full-body drawing of a person in profile. The person has a gentle stride, facing the left side. They have classical features with a straight nose and a calm expression. The person's hair is styled elaborately with waves around the face and a low bun at the back. They wear ornate armor with detailed designs on the chest plate and shoulder pieces, as well as a decorative skirt. A long sword hangs from their waist, and they wear intricately patterned greaves on their lower legs. They hold a helm adorned with swirling embellishments in their right hand. The background is a plain, light tone, highlighting the detailed figure.

artworks.title: View through the Trees at Tivoli [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched scene from a slightly elevated point of view, looking towards a group of buildings. The horizon is positioned at the upper third of the drawing, with the buildings, including a prominent tower, visible along it. The sketch is executed with delicate lines and soft shading. The brushstrokes are minimal, primarily composed of pencil lines and light watercolor wash to indicate depth and form. The overall color palette is subdued, consisting mostly of muted browns and grays, complementing the natural tan of the paper. Trees and foliage partially frame the view closest to us, with subtle hints of their forms leading the eye towards the structures in the distance. The background is sparse, allowing the viewer to focus on the architectural details.

artworks.title: View of a Mountain [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The sketch features faint contours of hills or mountains on the horizon line, with sparse pencil strokes outlining rolling hills and possible clusters of vegetation. The drawing is on a neutral background with minimal shading, giving it a calm and understated presence.

artworks.title: The Poleman in the Ma'sh
artworks.medium: brown wash heightened with white over graphite  and black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright with one arm on his waist and the other holding a long pole vertically beside him. He is wearing a cap, long-sleeved shirt, and pants. The background appears to be a marsh or wetland with vegetation. Loose sketches and notes are on the top part of the paper.

artworks.title: The Angel of the Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 21.6 x 17.6 cm (8 1/2 x 6 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an angelic figure facing the right and leaning slightly forward. The angel’s face is shown in profile, and they have long, wavy hair cascading down their shoulders, with a small braid wrapping around the side of their head. Their attire is a flowing robe with loose sleeves that drapes around their body. One of their hands is partially outstretched, and the other is near their chest, holding a long, slender object resembling a large feather. Large, feathery wings extend from the angel’s back on the left. The background of the drawing is plain, light brown paper with some areas of darker discoloration.

artworks.title: Giovanni da Bologna
artworks.medium: black and red chalks on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man from the shoulders up in a three-quarter view position facing slightly to the right. He has a lined face with prominent cheekbones, a full beard, and slightly narrowed eyes. He is wearing a hat with a rolled brim, a garment with a frilled collar, and a structured outer layer with visible seams. The background is a plain, light color, and there are faint sketches or handwriting above his head. The drawing is detailed with heavy lines for definition.

artworks.title: Standing Nude Girl
artworks.medium: charcoal on off-white laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length side profile drawing of a nude woman standing. Her body is turned slightly away from the viewer, with her right hand on her stomach and her left hand hanging by her side. Her facial features are in profile, including a sloping nose and closed lips. Her hair is in a short bob. She is not wearing any clothes, jewelry, or accessories. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: "It is good candles which light the way"
artworks.medium: pen and ink with brown wash and white heightening over black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows four figures mainly depicted from the waist up. The central figure holds a large, round-bottomed flask, looking slightly upward. To their left, another figure holds a candle on a candlestick, facing the flask. On the right, a person with short hair tied back holds another candle. Below them, another figure manipulates the base of a candle, with a dog looking up next to them. The setting is an interior with dark shading, suggesting a dim atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper, with later framing line in black ink
artworks.dimensions: overall (arched top): 44.6 x 29.1 cm (17 9/16 x 11 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate classical architectural setting with figures in robes. The scene depicts an interior with grandiose classical architecture, including large columns and intricate archways. The primary focus is on a group of figures gathered in a ceremonial scene, where one figure appears to be holding a small figure towards another. Other figures in the background are engaged in various activities. The use of pencil provides a detailed rendering of the characters' drapery and architectural elements. The drawing is bordered by a decorative green frame.

artworks.title: Head of a Macedonian Soldier
artworks.artist: Atelier Assistant of Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: pastel with black, red, and white chalk on laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a person's face in profile, wearing a dark, metallic helmet. The individual has a prominent nose, lips, short beard, and mustache. The skin tone is warm and earthy. The person has no visible hair above the helmet. The background is light brown and beige with subtle textures. No jewelry or additional objects are present.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man
artworks.medium: pastel and colored chalks on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper section of a man's face and body. He is facing forward, with his head slightly tilted, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a weathered face with pronounced features; his eyes are small and deeply set beneath bushy eyebrows, his skin has a ruddy tone, and he has a full white beard. His hair is long, curly, and tangled, framing his face with a mixture of darker and lighter shades. He is wearing a simple yellow garment with white underneath. The background is an indistinct, muted bluish-green, lacking any specific details.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gray wash and heightening over black chalk on prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a detailed painting of a classical scene with figures, statues, and grand architecture. The scene includes a central throne-like chair under a canopy, surrounded by individuals in dynamic poses. The architecture features tall arched structures with Corinthian columns, and unclothed human statues are placed around the area. The color palette is mainly warm earth tones, with a focus on red. The use of perspective draws attention to the central seated figure, creating depth and tension. Drapery and textiles add texture and movement to the scene. The style is reminiscent of Michelangelo, emphasizing idealized human forms and grand, architectural backgrounds from the Renaissance era.

artworks.title: Studies for Saint Anne in "Education of the Virgin"
artworks.medium: black, red and blue chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's face and hands. The woman's head is tilted up, looking towards the sky. Her face shows detailed features, with a neutral expression and her head covered by a cloth. The hands are shown, one under her chin and the other slightly raised with extended fingers. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Studies of a Man Drinking
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. The person has their right arm raised, holding a cup to their mouth with their left hand. The individual has defined facial features, including expressive eyes, a mustache, and distinct cheekbones. They wear a cap, and their visible hair is short. The person is dressed in a coat or jacket, indicated by the collar and layers. The background is a plain textured surface with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Sunlit Garden
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. A row of potted plants is in the foreground. In the middle ground, there are various trees and bushes, some with twisting trunks and branches depicted with pencil lines. In the background, tall hedges and house silhouettes can be seen. The drawing uses soft pencil strokes to create texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette of grey.

artworks.title: Christ and the Virgin with Music-Making Angels
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures sitting on clouds. In the center are two individuals with halos and wearing flowing garments, one with long hair. They are holding hands. Around them are angelic figures with wings and robes, displaying serene expressions. One angel plays a stringed instrument, and another holds an open book. The scene is framed within a triangular architectural arch. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Caliph Aladin and His Counselors
artworks.medium: black chalk (with extraneous marks in red chalk) on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing multiple figures and partial studies. To the left, there is a seated figure depicted from the waist up. This figure is draped in flowing garments and appears to be wearing a turban. The face is lightly sketched, with a hint of a beard and contemplative expression. Nearby, several sketches of individual hands and faces are drawn in various orientations. To the right, a standing figure is drawn from the waist up, dressed in a long coat with elaborate designs and a prominent tall hat, facing to the side. The facial features of this figure are minimally detailed. The sketch is composed on a plain, light background, with subtle stains and marks visible. The illustrations appear to be done in pencil with some red markings on the bottom left. The overall scene is one of an artist's exploration of form and figure.

artworks.title: Statue of a Female in a Toga
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture features a standing female figure draped in a long garment that covers most of her body, leaving her head and feet visible. The figure's head is slightly tilted, and her short hair is styled close to her head. She holds a portion of her clothing with one hand, creating an appearance of gentle motion in the fabric. The sculpture seems stylized, with simplified and smooth contours of the human form indicated. The drawing is monochrome, suggesting that the sculpture is likely a light-colored or marble material. The relative size and posture of the sculpture imply it stands at a similar height to humans but is depicted without intricate details, focusing instead on capturing the overall form and grace of the subject.

artworks.title: Statue of Abundance [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue. The image depicts a full-length figure in classical drapery. The figure wears a flowing robe that drapes over one shoulder and is gathered around the body. In the left hand, the figure holds an object resembling a cornucopia. The head is adorned with a laurel or helmet. The right arm is raised, but the specific gesture or object held is less defined. The drawing features soft shading and precise outlines.

artworks.title: Statue of a Roman Woman (Female Deity?) Seen from the Side [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a full-body figure standing on a rectangular platform. The person is standing with a slight forward lean, gesturing with one hand forward while the other is slightly bent at the elbow. The facial features are not detailed, and the head is rounded with simple hair indicated by a line around it. The person is wearing draped garments with lines showing folds and creases in the fabric. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a blank, textured surface with light smudges, emphasizing the sketched figure.

artworks.title: A Decorative Sculpture with a Woman Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 6.7 x 12.7 cm (2 5/8 x 5 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative architectural element and a sketch of a figure. The drawing features a highly ornate design on the left side with two mythical bird-like creatures facing each other with wings raised, possibly supporting a central medallion or roundel flanked by scrollwork. To the right, there is a simple outline of a human figure in motion, appearing to balance or carry something across their shoulders. The composition is composed of light pencil lines, indicating it may be a preliminary study or conceptual design. The drawing may serve as a preparatory piece, capturing an idea with quick and loose strokes.

artworks.title: Statue of a Male Nude with Hand on Hip
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 10.8 x 6 cm (4 1/4 x 2 3/8 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a full-length male figure. The man is standing with his body turned slightly to the side, his right hand resting on his hip, and his left arm extended slightly downward. His head is facing forward, with basic outlines for facial features, including eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is short and roughly sketched. The figure is depicted nude, emphasizing muscular details on the torso and legs, without any clothing or jewelry. The background is plain with no context, and there are a few lines at the bottom of the drawing.
